latest.prior_mean_definition: arithmetic mean of previous 12 complete monthly observations, current excluded

definitions.breadth: union of domains with H>0 / union with background_count>0; existing active_outlets definition
definitions.fixed_weight: 10000 * sum_s((1/128) * hnb_i(s,t)/background_i(s,t)); null if any frozen-panel denominator missing/zero
definitions.ranking: background_i >= 5000 AND hnb_i >= 50 in selected window
definitions.concentration: all HNB-carrying domains; no rate-ranking threshold
definitions.title: sum(title_mention_count) / sum(hnb_count); mechanical match only
